summary: A vehicle drove into Horsetooth Reservoir just south of the Skyline day-use area; the driver had died before rangers arrived. The submerged vehicle was located by sonar and recovered by the Larimer County dive team with airbags and a wrecker tow, in a multi-agency recovery effort.
location: Horsetooth Reservoir, just south of Skyline day-use area
notes: Parent scope call: INCLUDED as a recovery operation (driver deceased before rangers arrived) per the indexed body-recovery precedents ids 1032/2767 — the county dive team + rangers operation is the SAR element, flagged here not hidden. Multi-agency: LCSO, Larimer Natural Resources rangers, Fort Collins Natural Areas rangers, Poudre Fire Authority, Colorado State Patrol, coroner, county emergency services. Source published 2024-04-24; Friday-verified.
